data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Enumerate RED test specs explicitly: (a) test_pass_count_over_cap_exits_5 — fixture pass_record.json with count=150 for phase=bootstrap-throttle n=7 (cap=100) → exit 5, within_cap=false in dd3.json. (b) test_all_passes_within_cap_exits_0 — fixture all 8 passes ≤ cap → exit 0, overall_pass=true. (c) test_per_pass_series_schema — dd3.json has passes: [{n: int, cap: int, count: int, within_cap: bool}] exactly matching documented schema. (d) test_strict_phase_cap_10 — fixture pass_record.json with count=12 for phase=bootstrap-strict n=3 (cap=10) → exit 5. (e) test_missing_pass_log_dir_fails_closed — --pass-log-dir points to non-existent path → exit non-zero with diagnostic.
